name: Dungeons and Taverns Stronghold Overhaul
statusMeaning: Its content is data; Kiln 0.2.0 generates its structures in Horizon's worlds. Not tried in the game.

description:
This Datapack, the Standalone version of Dungeons and Taverns Overhaul of the Stronghold, Overhauls the Stronghold from the ground up With 417 Different rooms and 5 sub stronghold types
Fair warning, your world will Freeze Upon first Structure generation.
evidence: Data only, with 341 structure files: Kiln 0.2.0 generates structures from data in Horizon's worlds. Not tried in the game.
